name: [🏙️] +1 Speed Scary Tower Go Up
desc:
Welcome to +1 Speed Scary Tower Go Up

Every step you take you get +1 Speed,
Unlock Tools and Multipliers, and stand in "Save Zone" To save yourself
Reach to the top of the tower and Avoid the scary monster to win!

Be careful of heights if you have a fear of heights

This game was just made for fun with friends! Enjoy!

Don't forget to like👍and favorite!
